cases.customer_question: Is it mandatory to provide a user manual that includes Bluetooth pairing/operation details for the compliance folder, even if the product is not yet publicly released and the manual content is not accessible?
cases.actual_issue: Clarification of documentation requirements for the Compliance Folder, specifically whether a Bluetooth-related user manual is required at the time of qualification when the product is not yet launched.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant requested the Bluetooth-related portion of the user manual as part of the required Compliance Folder documentation. This indicates that documentation describing Bluetooth functionality (e.g., pairing/operation) is expected as part of qualification evidence, regardless of product release status.
cases.final_recommendation: Prepare and provide a Bluetooth-related user manual (or equivalent documentation describing pairing and operation) for the Compliance Folder, even if the product is not yet publicly released.
